::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: The toolkit for preparing clinical pathology data and uploading it to BigPicture. It helps you curate metadata, pseudonymise slides and metadata, check them against the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd), and upload. "SlideTap" names both the curation app and the set of components that [bp-submission-pipeline](../datasets/submission/index.qmd) installs together.

Who it's for
: Hospitals and research organisations contributing clinical data, and the technical staff who support them.

Provided by
: Developed by Sectra, with components by Deciphex. Each contributing site runs its own copy.

Before you start
: - You are onboarded as a BigPicture data contributor.
  - You have an [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login, for your upload credentials.
  - Installation currently needs help from the support team.

How to get access
: Install it with bp-submission-pipeline (recommended): follow the [Submission manual (clinical)](../datasets/submission/index.qmd). Advanced users can install the [components separately](../datasets/submission/direct-components/index.qmd).

Guides
: - [Submission manual (clinical)](../datasets/submission/index.qmd)
  - READMEs of the component repositories

Terms and privacy
: [Only the general BigPicture terms]{.proto-none}

Support
: ::: {.proto-support provider="Sectra (development) and the clinical upload support team" owner="[Name], Sectra" second="[Name], Sectra" hours="best effort"}
  :::

Related services
: [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd), [Metadata standard browser](metadata-browser.qmd), [Repository](repository.qmd), [Data transporter](data-transporter.qmd) (the non-clinical equivalent)

Source code
: [slidetap](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/slidetap), [bp-submission-pipeline](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline). Some components are private to the consortium.

## Before you start

- You are onboarded as a BigPicture data contributor.
- You have an [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login, for your upload credentials.
- Installation currently needs help from the support team. Contact the Service Desk before you begin.

## How to get access

The recommended route is bp-submission-pipeline, which installs all SlideTap components together. The [Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd) takes you through it. If you want to run the parts yourself, see [Direct components](../datasets/submission/direct-components/index.qmd).

::: {.proto-split}
::: {}
SlideTap gets clinical slides and their metadata from your hospital into BigPicture. It runs at your site, so patient data is pseudonymised before anything leaves.

::: {.proto-tasks}
::: {}
#### Set it up
Install with bp-submission-pipeline. [Start the Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd).
:::

::: {}
#### Prepare a dataset
Curate the metadata and check it against the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd).
:::

::: {}
#### Upload
Send a test dataset first, then go to production.
:::
:::

Installing SlideTap still needs a hand from the support team, so get in touch before your first submission. Non-clinical data goes through the [Data transporter](data-transporter.qmd) instead.
